correctness.rationale: Choose smooth even compact cutoff χ=1 on [-2,2], 0 outside [-3,3], c(x)=∫0^xχ(u)du, f0=0,f1=2∫0^xc(u)du. Gradients g0=0,g1=2c are globally bounded, all derivatives bounded, and sample losses globally Lipschitz C∞. For shared-sample two-stage stochastic Heun starting X0=1 with h=1/n, all predictors/states remain [0,1], where c=x. Sample0 update multiplier 1, sample1 multiplier 1−2h+2h², so E X_n=(1−h+h²)^n=e^-1(1+1/(2n)+O(n^-2)). The authors' noise-only target dZ=−c(Z)dt+√h|c(Z)|dW, started at 1, matches geometric Brownian dG=−Gdt+√hGdW unless an exponentially rare escape above 2; exponential reflection bound and uniform second moments prove E Z_1=e^-1+O(exp(−C/h)). Hence lim n(E X_n−E Z_1)=1/(2e). General one-step mean mismatch is h²/2 Cov(g_gamma'(x),g_gamma(x)), nonzero at x=1; ordinary local weak error O(h²) yields global order 1 against the asserted target, not claimed alternative modified equations. Independently evaluated exact multipliers and scaled errors at increasing n, tending to 1/(2e). Source original equations (5), (6) and Theorem1 were read in accessible complete HTML version and checked for same-stage sampling.
